item.title: Inject explicit mode indicator into architect prompt assembly
item.intent: The architect agent must know which mode it is operating in (review vs groom) via an explicit injected line, not by inferring from which sections were stripped.
steps: Find where the orchestrator strips Review/Groom mode sections from the architect prompt
After stripping, inject a line like 'You are in [review|groom] mode' at the top of the assembled prompt
This is an orchestrator assembly change, not an agent prompt rewrite

acceptanceCriteria.text: Orchestrator injects mode indicator into architect prompt
